end.summary: Practised multiplying numbers ending in zeros by multiplying non-zero parts and counting zeros.
end.parentNote: Rudra practised multiplying numbers ending in zeros and correctly used the method in two unaided attempts. They also tried estimating products by rounding, but the rounded product was not yet completed accurately. Rudra mixed up the number of zeros when a non-zero product already ended in zero; this was still confusing at the end. At home, practise a few examples such as 50 × 60 and write the non-zero multiplication and zero count in separate steps.
